results.expected: Budgets unchanged, expense back in Dining, audit complete, proposals clean.

results.reason: G1 verified: budgets unchanged, expense back in Dining, audit complete.

results.expected: Monthly total expenses increase by 19.00; 3 rows added; audit logged.
